# Journal of Research in Psychopathology

> > An open-access, peer-reviewed academic journal publishing original research on psychopathology, mental disorders, and clinical psychology under the University of Mohaghegh Ardabili.

JRP is a COPE-compliant, double-blind peer-reviewed journal indexed in major academic databases including DOAJ, APA PsycInfo, and Ebsco. The journal operates under CC BY-NC 4.0 Creative Commons licensing and maintains rigorous ethical standards through iThenticate plagiarism detection and COPE-aligned publication practices.

## Journal Overview

- [Journal Homepage](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir): Homepage for Journal of Research in Psychopathology, a peer-reviewed open-access academic journal.
- [About Journal](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/about): About page describing JRP's mission, scope, and editorial leadership under University of Mohaghegh Ardabili.
- [Aims and Scope](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/aim_scope): Defines JRP's research scope, publication aims, and focus areas in psychopathology and mental illness.
- [Editorial Board](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/editorial.board): Lists editorial board members including Editor Sajjad Basharpoor and international psychology experts.

## Submission & Review Process

- [Guide for Authors](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/authors.note): Comprehensive guide for authors on manuscript submission, APA style formatting, and JRP policies.
- [Peer Review Process](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/process): Documents JRP's double-blind peer review process, submission guidelines, and COPE-compliant ethics standards.

## Publication Ethics & Policies

- [Publication Ethics and Malpractice Statement](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/p_pem): Specifies JRP's publication ethics policies, author responsibilities, and malpractice prevention measures.
- [Plagiarism Policy](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/page_22.html): Outlines JRP's plagiarism detection using iThenticate and COPE-compliant integrity standards.
- [Copyright and Licensing Statement](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/page_20.html): Specifies JRP's CC BY-NC 4.0 Creative Commons licensing and author copyright terms.
- [Open Access Statement](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/page_21.html): Explains JRP's open access model and CC BY-NC 4.0 Creative Commons licensing terms.
- [Self-archiving Policy](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/page_23.html): Details JRP's self-archiving policy for preprints and postprints in institutional repositories.

## Indexing & Archives

- [Indexing and Abstracting](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/journal/indexing): Lists JRP's indexing in DOAJ, APA PsycInfo, Ebsco, and other major academic databases.
- [Author Index](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/author.index): Alphabetical index of published authors in JRP's journal archives and volumes.
- [Keyword Index](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/keyword.index): Keyword-based search interface for navigating JRP's published research articles and archives.

## Published Articles

- [Volume 7, Issue 1 - Articles List](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/volume_698.html): List of peer-reviewed articles in JRP Volume 7, Issue 1 on psychopathology and mental health.
- [Volume 7, Issue 1 - Full Articles](https://jrp.uma.ac.ir/issue_698_699.html): Articles from JRP Volume 7, Issue 1 covering ADHD, depression, anxiety, and clinical psychology.
